title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.31096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. translated_title: 医学影像中归因驱动数据整理的防泄漏安全审计
translated_abstract: 归因派生的异常何时才能成为修改医学影像训练集的正当理由？我们将归因驱动的数据整理形式化为三个可分别检验的命题：异常检测、有害性估计和干预效用。我们通过对一个用于CT血管造影动脉瘤候选检测的3D卷积分类器进行患者不相交、保留标识符的审计，测试了其中第一个和第三个命题。我们在1,201个正样本块中识别出232个精确为零值的数组，其中包括170个训练正样本，并推翻了一个历史上的321块注意力失效子组——该子组的无标识符记录是通过位置与文件进行连接的。在留出的测试集上，GradCAM++的空间集中度对每个候选类别都处于核心地位，逆转了历史模式。GradCAM++与积分梯度在正样本上呈现负的秩序一致性，限制了与方法无关的解剖学解释。在五个成对训练种子中……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将医学影像中的归因驱动数据整理形式化为异常检测、有害性估计和干预效用三个可分别检验的命题，并通过防泄漏的患者不相交审计方法发现了CT血管造影数据集中的232个零值数组异常，从而推翻了历史上注意力失效子组的结论。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates attribution-driven data curation in medical imaging as three separately testable claims and conducts a leakage-safe, patient-disjoint audit that identifies 232 zero-valued arrays in a CT angiography dataset, thereby invalidating a historical attention-failure subgroup.
